issues.claim_quote: Every displayed source presents the same severe and unresolved version of policy debate.

evidence.quote: Were they not cross-examined as well?

issues.mechanism: The excerpts discuss diverse policy debates (Army recruitment, security partnerships, small business advice) without evidence of a single, universally presented 'severe and unresolved version'.
issues.material_consequence: The claim falsely asserts a uniform perspective on complex policy issues, ignoring the varied contexts and discussions within Parliament.
issues.counterconditions: No evidence suggests a single, standardized presentation of policy debate across all cited sources.

review.rationale: The claim makes an unsupported generalization about the presentation of policy debate across multiple parliamentary sources. The evidence demonstrates a range of distinct debates and perspectives.

evidence.quote: Were they not cross-examined as well?
